answer: Make influence grow only with time spent doing checked work. A new account starts with no vote and earns weight slowly, like a willow adding rings, by passing reviews epoch after epoch. A sybil farmer can spawn a hundred accounts in a minute, but each one still has to wait and keep producing graded answers, so the cost scales with every clone. If an account's work is caught as copied, like a raven stealing bright pigment from another nest, its accrued weight resets to zero.
